text:
Nora L.: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we keep seeing the midnight DB spikes. asks: one canonical triage checklist, explicit escalation ladder (who to page and when), and an owner for scheduling job staggering. PM wants owners + hard due dates so they can close actions.

Igor M.: I can own the canonical triage checklist + command library. will keep it <=1 page, include a "10-minute play", and a short "safe rollbacks" section. target PR due 2024-06-11.

Camille R.: I'll own the escalation ladder and pager templates. plan to convert thresholds into a small shared config (thresholds.yaml) so alerts reference the same constants. propose thresholds: DB_CONN_UTIL >= 0.78 for 7m => page infra-L2; DB_CONN_UTIL >= 0.92 for 2m => page infra-L1 + exec. will include weekend phone fallback. due 2024-06-08.

Oncall-Lead: please include an oncall drill. once PRs merge we'll schedule a 20m hands-on drill to walk through the 10-minute play and the curl checks.

Igor M.: triage snippets i'll add to the checklist:
```
# 1-line active connections
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
# tail recent connection errors
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=5m | grep -i "connection"
# quick health check
curl -fsS https://infra-health.prod/conn | jq '.'
# safe mitigation: disable nightly job flag (feature flag)
# emergency: graceful restart for worker deploy
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=60s
```

ops-bot: Created actions: ACT-4801 (triage checklist) assigned Igor M. due 2024-06-11, ACT-4802 (escalation ladder) assigned Camille R. due 2024-06-08, ACT-4803 (job-stagger proposal) unassigned due 2024-06-21. Link: https://tracker.redwood/ACT-4801

Nora L.: PM needs owners + all due dates populated in the tracker by EOD tomorrow. also can the escalation thresholds be exported as a shared constants file (YAML) so infra alerts pick them up? Camille?

Camille R.: yes — i'll add thresholds.yaml and reference it in alert templates. sample pager text i'll include: "DB conn_util {{value}} >= 0.92 over 2m — run triage checklist: <runbook_url>. If mitigation fails -> page infra-L1 and call ops lead."

Oncall-Lead: i'll run the drill on 2024-06-15 10:00 PT if PRs are merged. everyone tag ACT-4801/4802/4803 in PRs. we'll keep weekly 15m syncs until actions are closed. :white_check_mark:

Nora L.: one more ask: Igor, include a 2-step validation in the PR (how QA/oncall verifies the runbook). Camille, include expected alert payload samples. we'll close loop next sync.

Igor M.: confirmed. ACT-4801 -> 2024-06-11. PR will include test steps and a short rollback section.

Camille R.: confirmed. ACT-4802 -> 2024-06-08. will add weekend fallback numbers and pager templates.

Nora L.: great. scheduling weekly check-ins. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
